# Vendored AWS SDK manifest

Generated 2026-08-30 from official npm registry artifacts. npm verified each downloaded tarball against the registry `dist.integrity` value recorded below. The browser ESM bundle was produced locally with esbuild 0.25.9 from these exact sources; it has no residual module imports or dependency-loading calls. The SDK's legitimate runtime HTTP transport and inert endpoint metadata remain bundled. esbuild is a release-time tool only and is not shipped.

## Shipped files

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| `aws-sdk.js` | 198692 | `ac1b6e92dfb11b9059ad4eb734085ef7c0ad7c339c0f6c623d1d3cd5d59132f7` |

Direct entry packages: `@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb@3.1121.0`, `@aws-sdk/credential-provider-cognito-identity@3.972.69`, and `@aws-sdk/util-dynamodb@3.996.9`.

`npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` reported 0 vulnerabilities for
this exact runtime closure on 2026-08-30.

## Reproducible checks

`sha256sum js/vendor/aws-sdk.js` must match the hash above. A release check must also reject dynamic imports, static import/re-export specifiers, and string-literal CommonJS dependency loads in the bundle. Every shipped file is explicitly listed in `SHELL_ASSETS` in `sw.js`.
